profile.headline: Software Developer
profile.summary: Experienced Manager  and Application Developer with a demonstrated history of working in the government relations industry. Skilled in U.S. Department of Defense, Government, Business Process Improvement, System Administration, and SharePoint. Strong information technology professional with a .Net Master Program focused in C#, WCF, Web Development, T-SQL from SetFocus.

positions.title: Program Manager
positions.description: Responsible for performance of work for the “Forensic Toxicology Drug and test Laboratories” (FTDTL) team.  This includes overseeing schedules, purchases, performance of programs, assist with proposal preparation. I develop and ensure master plans and schedules are followed and direct others for successful completion of projects on time and on budget. I work closely with upper management and stakeholders which includes the (COR) Contracting Officer Representative to ensure deliverables are met with regards to the Performance of Work Statement.  I regularly review for accountability and successful management of projects, stakeholders and suppliers. Currently my team consist of 20 members.

positions.title: Technical Team Lead
positions.description: Responsible for maintenance of web and windows applications written in C#, ASP.Net, WPF and MVC 4.  Assist with Oracle and SQL database scripting design and scripting. Compile week status reports for all projects which informs management of project progress, outstanding issues and risk for development team of 3.  create Oracle and SQL relational database to store data.

positions.title: .NET Applications Developer
positions.description: Manage and developer for the Personnel Automated Records Information System (PARIS) for the United States Air Force Civilian personnel.  Ensure the team adhere to project scope, meet deadlines and requirements for all production work orders. Perform initial application feasibility study, create design specifications, write code, test applications and suggest options for performance improvement of technical objects.  Install new releases, and patches across all tiers. Provide continued maintenance and development of bug fixes and patch sets. Provide documentation on start-up, shut down and first level troubleshooting of processes to help desk. Advocate for end-users to perform testing and problem analysis for desktop work.  Windows and web application developer using latest developing software and strategies for quality results.

positions.title: Intergrations Manager
positions.description:
Hire and Manage team of engineers to support Citrix products, routers, firewalls, NetScalers and Internet appliances.
Supervised Engineers to maintain a minimum 70% billing rate. Manage final design integration/requirements verification for project engineering work products, in addition to the cost center within integrated project schedule. 
Advised clients on how to use Citrix Best Practices effectively. Design, install, and maintain Citrix Farms.			
Project Team Lead for new installs and enhancements. Supervise creative projects from conception to completion while managing outside vendors.  Some successful projects include:
¥	South Texas Oncology & Hematology center – Manage team to install first Citrix Farm for 200 + users.
¥	American Bank – Diagnose and enhance performance of Citrix Farm.
¥	Well Med – Manage team to install and maintain Citrix Farm.
¥	FBD Frozen – Manage team to install Thin Clients.
